claims.claim: Applied Digital said a 15-year take-or-pay hyperscaler lease at Polaris Forge 3 brought contracted capacity above 1 GW and baseline contracted revenue to $31B, subject to project delivery and contract terms.

factors.name: AI infrastructure demand and contracted capacity
factors.basis: long-duration hyperscaler commitments support demand visibility for power-dense AI data-center capacity

risks.risk: Large contracted pipeline requires substantial construction capital, utility delivery and tenant concentration management.

causalEdges.mechanism: AI clusters require scarce grid-connected high-density capacity
causalEdges.falsifier: tenant commitments are cancelled, delayed, or fail to convert into operating rent

unknowns.unknown: Tenant concentration and project-by-project financing economics require underwriting.

claims.claim: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue was $258.7M, up 407% year over year; adjusted EBITDA was $42.4M. Fiscal-year revenue was $611.3M, while year-end cash/restricted cash was $4.2B against $5.0B of debt.

factors.name: execution and operating scale
factors.basis: rapid revenue scaling and positive adjusted EBITDA show conversion of the first HPC campus into reported operations

risks.risk: GAAP net loss remained large and debt exceeded cash/restricted cash at fiscal year-end.

causalEdges.from: commissioned HPC capacity and tenant fit-outs
causalEdges.mechanism: operational campuses begin recognizing rent and fit-out service revenue
causalEdges.falsifier: new campus openings fail to produce durable rental cash economics

unknowns.unknown: No valuation conclusion is asserted; normalized economics excluding fit-out revenue need underwriting.
